cases.trigger: No server LLM environment variable and no request-scoped page key.
cases.expected_result: POST /api/generate returns structured 503 LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED; page keeps need_human_review visible.

cases.trigger: PaddleOCR or PaddlePaddle cannot import in the target runtime.
cases.expected_result: OCR parse fails with sanitized OCR error; normal fake-OCR automated tests remain valid.

cases.trigger: A text-layer PDF is parsed in parse_mode=auto.
cases.expected_result: Docling text parsing succeeds without OCR; ocr_attempted remains false.

cases.trigger: Text parsing fails or produces no chunks for a scanned PDF.
cases.expected_result: parse_mode=auto attempts OCR fallback when optional OCR runtime is available.

cases.trigger: 18 MB, 37 MB, 194 MB, or 229 MB catalog materials are selected for the demo baseline.
cases.expected_result: Do not use as Phase 11 fixed baseline; defer until parser memory and timeout behavior are tested.

cases.trigger: User asks whether certificates, seals, or qualification evidence are authentic.
cases.expected_result: Out of scope; show extracted evidence and require human/legal review.
